description:
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Astral Cornucopia.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat.

uses.name: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment
Astral Cornucopia
uses.cardState: with two or more charge counters on it
